name: ElectroBlocks
description:
I've just started ElectroBlocks - a vanilla anarchy server on bedrock edition. I wanted to create a genuine bedrock experience without cross-play or unnecessary changes to the game.

There are very few rules, allowing you to play however you want. The map is brand new.

The server is whitelisted, but new players are welcome. Fill out the form and you'll be added.

Apply at: https://forms.gle/PGvs9pjRXrgfADJ49

The gameplay is vanilla at its core, with homes and teleporting added for convenient travel across the map.

Rules:

Raiding and griefing are allowed.

No hacks or exploits

No dupes or glitches that give an unfair advantage

Don't try to lag or crash the server
